card.name: Any component of this product
card.fires_on: The word "component" (or the "of" right after it) in contraindication phrases like "hypersensitivity to any component of this product".

modes.label: Component in hypersensitivity phrase
modes.description: The word "component" after "hypersensitivity to ... any" in a contraindications list.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Hypersensitivity to any<< component>> of this product. Concomitant use

modes.label: Of after component
modes.description: The word "of" following "any component" before "this product".
modes.example: hypersensitivity to revefenacin or any component<< of>> this product. YUPELRI
